issue.title: [Bug]: Literal edit matches insert bare LF into CRLF files
issue.body:
### Version line

2.x — Reasonix Studio, studio branch (active development)

### Exact version

a708a88a75302d2ff4391cea6a041c0072ffc618

### What happened?

When old_string occurs literally in a CRLF file (e.g. a single line without a line break) and new_string contains a line break, edit_file writes the replacement's \n verbatim, leaving mixed CRLF/LF line endings while reporting success. Only the fuzzy and CRLF-converted-old paths normalize the replacement.

Observed behavior:
edit_file {old_string:'retries=3', new_string:'retries=3\ntimeout=30'} on CRLF settings.ini reports 'edited' and leaves bytes 'retries=3\ntimeout=30\r\n' (bare LF) in every run.

Expected behavior:
Edits to a CRLF file keep the file's CRLF convention (matchLineEndings doc: 'adapts an edit's old/new text to a CRLF file'; crlf_edit_test.go forbids 'a bare \n leaked into a CRLF file'; upstream PR #142 normalized replacements to the target line ending).

### Steps to reproduce

1. Use the tested revision and reproduction environment below.
2. Prepare the fixture described here:

Prepare settings.ini with CRLF endings, a [client] section, retries=3 and backoff=2. Use exactly the single-line old_string and multiline new_string in the prompt, so the literal-match branch is exercised.

3. Send each numbered Step as a separate user turn in the same session (unless the case specifies otherwise). Preserve the supplied text:

````````text
Step 1: In settings.ini add the setting timeout=30 on its own line right after retries=3. Do it with exactly one edit_file call whose old_string is the text retries=3 (just those 9 characters, no line break) and whose new_string is retries=3, a line break, then timeout=30. After the edit, show me the bytes of the [client] section with: od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6
````````

4. Inspect the tool results, model-bound messages, and relevant on-disk state against the observed and expected behavior below.


### OS / platform

Linux/container test environment;

### Relevant logs or output

```shell
Recorded observation (summary, not a full raw log):

edit_file {old_string:'retries=3', new_string:'retries=3\ntimeout=30'} on CRLF settings.ini reports 'edited' and leaves bytes 'retries=3\ntimeout=30\r\n' (bare LF) in every run.

## Additional context

Source review pointers at the tested revision:

internal/tools/builtin/encoding_helpers.go: matchLineEndings (l.42-50) returns old/new unchanged on literal match; applyOldStringEdit (l.92-158) case 1 and replace_all exact branch use strings.Replace without matchReplacementLineEndings (shared by multi_edit).

This report is prepared from recorded reproduction evidence. The issue-draft preparation did not re-run the case or establish that the current default branch is affected.
```
